node.title: When the Controls Work but the System Fails
node.reading: This article explains the foundations and public significance of the Ecosystem Awareness work. It synthesizes constructed failure scenarios, source-based technology walkthroughs, derived requirements and a candidate architecture. The technical annexes and cited canonical repositories contain the verification record. Publication on Tegrity.AI does not imply peer review, independent validation, production readiness, adoption as a standard or endorsement by the ITU, FG-TIDA or any cited organisation.
node.readingSummary: This article explains the foundations and public significance of the Ecosystem Awareness work.

relations: Component-level compliance does not establish ecosystem-level integrity when independently governed actors compose their decisions under changing conditions.
Los seis escenarios EA son construidos y no prueban frecuencia de estos fallos en una población de despliegues.
Industrial delivery is complete only when the composed chain supports customer production readiness; passing each local control does not establish that end-to-end outcome.
El paralelo no afirma que el caso utilizara la arquitectura EA ni atribuye a ésta las mejoras comerciales reportadas.
The case raises a composition question: locally plausible actions can still require a system-level check of relationships, authority and changed context.
La síntesis de EA declara su estado explicativo. Ni analogía ni publicación acreditan validación o preparación de producción.
